tasks.label: Padaone : vérifier (fmt + clippy + tests)
tasks.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace

tasks.label: Padaone : diagnostic Wi-Fi (lecture seule)
tasks.command: nmcli -t -f DEVICE,TYPE,STATE,CONNECTION device status && for d in $(nmcli -t -f DEVICE,TYPE device status | awk -F: '$2=="wifi"{print $1}'); do echo "--- $d"; nmcli -f WIFI-PROPERTIES device show "$d"; done
